keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «미나와 아빠는 엄마를 깜짝 놀라게 해 주고 싶다(하고 싶은 일)» 와 «엄마가 기쁨의 눈물을 흘린다(결과)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the goal (Mina and Dad want to surprise Mom) and the result (Mom laughs and cries happy tears). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: What do they want to do?
boxes.a: They want to surprise Mom on her birthday.
Mom laughs and cries happy tears.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: . Mina draws a card with a big red
all over the living room, and Mom cries happy tears.

words: Mina and Dad want to surprise her.
to do something nice that someone does not know about yet
While Mom is at work, they bake a cake.
Mina draws a card with a big red heart.
a folded paper with a message on it
They put balloons all over the living room.
soft colorful toys filled with air
water that comes from your eyes

opts: She does not like the cake.
evs: Mom laughs and cries happy tears.
When Mom comes home, they shout, "Surprise!"
While Mom is at work, they bake a cake.
why: 엄마는 «happy tears», 곧 기뻐서 눈물을 흘려요.
Mom cries "happy tears." She is very happy.

qs.q: "Mina and Dad want to surprise her." What does "surprise" mean here?
qs.qko: «want to surprise her» 에서 «surprise» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: do something nice that she does not know about
evs: Mina and Dad want to surprise her.
Mina draws a card with a big red heart.
They put balloons all over the living room.
Mom laughs and cries happy tears.
why: «surprise» 는 «엄마가 모르게 좋은 일을 준비해서 깜짝 놀라게 하다» 예요.
"Surprise" means to do something nice that she does not know about yet.

qs.q: How do Mina and Dad get ready for the surprise?
qs.qko: 미나와 아빠는 깜짝 파티를 어떻게 준비하나요?
opts: They bake a cake and put up balloons.
They buy a dog and a cat.
They go to a big restaurant.
evs: While Mom is at work, they bake a cake.
They put balloons all over the living room.
Mom laughs and cries happy tears.
why: 둘은 케이크를 굽고, 거실에 풍선을 달아요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
They bake a cake and put balloons all over the living room. You need both sentences.

ends: Mom plans a surprise for Mina's birthday.
엄마가 미나의 생일 깜짝 파티를 준비한다.
The family eats the cake and plays games.
가족이 함께 케이크를 먹고 게임을 한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)
